artifact-name.description: Name of the uploaded report artifact

cache.description: Cache the baseline database between runs ('true' or 'false')

comment.description: Post a PR comment with the result ('true' or 'false'; needs pull-requests write permission)

fail-on.description: Comma-separated severities that fail the gate (empty = use gate.fail_on from the config)

mode.description: auto (push to the default branch = baseline, otherwise candidate), baseline or candidate

python-version.description: Python version used to run SpecAgent

cache-matched-key.description: Restored baseline cache key, or empty when none was restored

comment-status.description: posted or unavailable when the PR comment was attempted; empty when skipped

gate-exit-code.description: CLI gate exit code (0 passed, 1 blocked, 2 configuration error)

CreateProjectRequest.description: Project metadata only; never configures an adapter or a target.
CreateProjectRequest.title: CreateProjectRequest

LLMJudgeVerdict.description:
LLM Judge output — roadmap §8.4 requires this exact structure: a bare
natural-language 'the model thinks it failed' is never accepted.
LLMJudgeVerdict.title: LLMJudgeVerdict

Probe.description:
A probe drives the generic generator (v1 design §5.1/§5.5): either a
literal `text` or a `template` with `{arg}` / `{actor.field}` placeholders
(never str.format).
Probe.title: Probe

ProjectRunRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/project/runs (方案 B): deliberately minimal.

The browser can never choose the spec, adapter, project, endpoint or the
gate — those come only from the server-side SPECAGENT_PROJECT_CONFIG file.
Unknown fields are rejected so a client cannot smuggle any of them in.
ProjectRunRequest.title: ProjectRunRequest

ReviewRequest.description: Human review verdict for a critical rule result (roadmap §8.3 layer 4).
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

TraceEvent.description:
Normalized trace event (roadmap 7.1).

Upstream adapters may omit id/seq/timestamp; the normalizer fills them in
(`evt_<seq>`), so every judge verdict can cite concrete evidence ids.
TraceEvent.title: TraceEvent

post.description:
Human review of a critical-rule result (roadmap §8.3 layer 4).

Records the verdict permanently on the execution; does not change the
deterministic status — the review trail is kept alongside it.

get.description: Observability metrics (§9.2) for the dashboard's four questions (§9.3).

Describe the configured target (read-only). The payload carries counts
and labels only — no paths, no env values, no URLs with credentials.

post.description:
Legacy v0.1 endpoint: compile from text, execute, and return everything.

Kept for backward compatibility; it now also persists the run and diffs
against the project baseline.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Runs Get

post.description: Execute a behavior test run (roadmap §14.4 POST /api/runs).

Cancel a run in flight (roadmap §10.2): already-executed cases keep
their results; cases not yet started become CANCELED.
